sources.title: Samsung Electronics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results

statements.text: Samsung Electronics reported consolidated revenue of KRW 171.5 trillion for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Samsung Electronics reported consolidated operating profit of KRW 89.5 trillion for the second quarter of 2026.
Samsung Electronics stated that its Device Solutions division recorded KRW 127.5 trillion in revenue and KRW 89.2 trillion in operating profit in the second quarter of 2026.
The concentration of second-quarter operating profit in Device Solutions indicates that semiconductor conditions were the dominant earnings driver in this frozen analysis period.
Future earnings could remain sensitive to memory pricing, AI-server demand, product mix, and execution; this is a scenario statement rather than a reported company fact.
